## About Dr. Aryan Parmar

Dr. Aryan Parmar is the founder and lead dentist at YOUR DENTIST Patna. He completed his BDS from Patna Dental College & Hospital and holds multiple advanced international credentials:

- **Fellowship in Implantology** — South Korea (International)
- **Fellowship in Aesthetic Dentistry (FAD)** — Advanced cosmetic dental training
- **Clinical Implant Mastership** — DENTIS (South Korean implant authority)
- **Best Youngest Dentist 2022** — Bihar State Award by the Indian Dental Association (IDA)

Dr. Parmar specializes in painless, computerized implant surgery, smile makeovers, porcelain veneers, composite bonding, and invisible aligners.

## Treatments Offered

### Dental Implants
Computerized, single-session dental implant placements using premium DENTIS (South Korea) implants. Full mouth rehabilitation also available. Treatment includes 3D planning, surgical guide placement, and crown fitting.

### Clear Aligners / Invisible Braces
Custom-fabricated invisible aligners for straightening misaligned teeth without metal braces. Treatment duration: 6–18 months. Available at EMI starting from ₹3,500/month.

### Metal & Ceramic Braces
Traditional and ceramic bracket orthodontic treatments for all malocclusion types. Results in 12–24 months.

### Porcelain Veneers
Thin ceramic shells bonded to the front of teeth for permanent smile enhancement. Used for gap closure, chip repair, discoloration, and shape correction. Completed in 2 sessions over 7 days.

### Composite Veneers / Composite Bonding
Single-visit smile makeover using tooth-coloured resin material. Fixes chips, gaps, stains, and irregular tooth shapes. Zero drilling, zero pain, reversible.

### Laser Teeth Whitening
Professional whitening delivering 6–8 shades of improvement in a single 60-minute session. Safe, enamel-preserving, and long-lasting.

### Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
Painless root canal using computerized rotary endodontic files. 99% pain-free with local anaesthesia. Completed in 1–2 sessions.

### Teeth Scaling & Polishing
Professional tartar removal and gum cleaning every 6 months. Prevents gingivitis and periodontal disease.

### Wisdom Tooth Extraction
Painless surgical and simple extractions of impacted or erupted wisdom teeth using micro-surgical techniques.

### Smile Makeover
Comprehensive aesthetic treatment planning combining whitening, veneers, gum contouring, and orthodontic alignment.
